abstract.t:
This document describes HiAE, a high-throughput authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) algorithm. It targets next- generation wireless systems (6G) and high-speed data transmission applications. This document also specifies its use as a stream cipher and a message authentication code (MAC).
Discussion Venues
This note is to be removed before publishing as an RFC.
Source for this draft and an issue tracker can be found at https://github.com/hiae-aead/draft-pham-hiae.
